name: Qing Zai Huimie Zhiqian Ai Wo
source:
You (the player), who have strayed into the game world, decide to cooperate with Administrator 0600 in order to return to the real world.

Replace the missing heroine—CHEN, YAN-WEI—and win over the character WU, MING-SHI until the good ending is reached.

However, this world that was supposed to be full of romantic vibes had already gotten out of control before you came.

A gradually crumbling world, pursuers from unknown origins, uncontrollable plotlines, and characters slowly losing control of themselves.

Can you let him obtain happiness before everything is destroyed?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5075330/_Love_me_before_we_perish/]Steam[/url]]
